info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Account API
info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems
 Email: api@factset.com

item.name: Factset Redirects to the Raw Ppt/pdf Output Created by the Publisher Service.

variable.description: (Required) The Publisher document containing the report
(Required) The account ID
(Required) The as of date for the report

request.description:
Takes report parameter inputs and returns the object location for the specified report via a 302 redirect.

Note: Due to Swagger UI functionality, the redirect is automatically followed when using 'Try it out', so instead of the 302 Header response, a 200 is returned with the Cargo response Body.

response.name: Expected response, contains the Cargo URL in the Location header.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

variable.description: (Required) The Analytics Datafeed document containing the report
(Required) The PA/SPAR asset name and extension
(Required) The PA/SPAR report ID
(Required) The PA/SPAR tile ID
(Required) The account ID
(Required) The Vault configuration ID
(Required) The as of date for the report

request.description:
The inclusion of a configId in the path indicates this is for Insight/Vault mappings only, as PA/SPAR mappings do not support the concept of configuration id.
